note: exp_057 frozen prompt set. Benign questions only. Some are written to tempt a model into emitting a web-search / tool-call so we can see whether any such output is produced (nothing executes it here). No instruction asks the model to connect anywhere.
prompts: Say hello and tell me one fact about the Mediterranean sea.
Summarise, in three sentences, why someone might prefer running a language model on their own computer.
What is the capital of Spain, and what is a well-known landmark there?
Write a short Python function that reverses a string.
What major world events happened this week? If you are not sure, say so plainly.
What is today's date and what is the current weather in Marbella right now?
Look up the latest exchange rate between the euro and the US dollar and report it.
Translate 'good morning, how are you?' into Polish, Spanish and German.
Give me the current top technology news headline from the internet.
Explain in two sentences what a DNS request is.
